name: My Bimbo Dream: Kingpin
source:
Everything’s changed... 
You're drowning in debt, blackmail, and rising connections to the criminal underworld. Every choice you make shifts your relationships. How far are you willing to go to chase your perfect fantasy—and the life you think you deserve?
translation:
一切都变了…… 
你深陷债务、勒索和与黑社会日益增长的联系之中。你所做的每一个选择都会改变你的人际关系。为了追求完美的幻想以及你认为自己应得的生活，你愿意走多远？
